name: InsertChild
source: lane MC: 0x93061a jumps to 0x9334c2, which adds the child to the list and calls the child's slot 12 with this; cGZLegacyControl::Create 0x86dfdc hands its new window to its parent through it

name: RemoveChild
source: lane MC: 0x9307cc jumps to 0x93369f; cGZLegacyControl's destructor 0x85d82b takes an owned window from its parent through it before Teardown

name: BringToFront
source: lane MC: 0x9325c5 calls the parent's (+0x58) slot 31 with this, false without a parent; cGZLegacyControl::Create 0x86dfdc calls it once the window is placed

name: SetAreaRect
source: lane MC: 0x62ab36 calls SetArea (slot 64) with the rectangle's four words; cGZLegacyControl's render face slot 4 0x86def0 forwards to it

name: UpdateAnchors
source: lane MC: 0x9332bd copies the area (+0xc8) to +0x14, then by the anchor flags (0x10, 0x800000, 0x1000000, 0x2000000) subtracts the parent's width / height (slots 49 / 50); cGZLegacyControl::Create 0x86dfdc calls it when IsFlagSet(0x3800010)

name: SetProperty
source: lane MC: 0x932f99 replaces the counted object stored under id in the map at +0x98 (the old one released, the new one AddRef'd; null removes); true. cGZLegacyControl::Create 0x86dfdc stores the class and type ids there as uint32 variants

name: SetAnchorArea
source: lane MD: 0x932f82 copies the four words to +0x14 (the anchor rectangle) and calls 0x933d91, which recomputes the area (+0xc8) from it and the parent's size by the anchor flags (SetArea, slot 64); ret 4. ApplyCommonProperties 0x86549d hands it the 0x101 area text's rectangle

name: MoveTo
source: lane MD: 0x930f79 is SetArea(x, y, x + width, y + height), ret 8; ApplyCommonProperties 0x86549d moves the window to the 0x102 position

name: SetBackgroundColor
source: lane MD: 0x932c18 packs the three bytes into +0xf4 (red highest), which GetBackgroundColor (slot 142, 0x931727) reads; ret 0xc. ApplyCommonProperties 0x86549d sets it from the 0x104 colour text

name: GetChildInterface
source: lane MD: 0x9311e3 is GetChildWindowFromID (slot 38) then that child's QueryInterface(iid, out); false without the child; ret 0xc (slot 45 is the recursive form). LoadUIScript 0xb41b50 asks a text edit's window for its scrollbars (ids 0 and 1, iid 0x4b42da53)

name: GetProperty
source: lane MD: 0x931763 finds id in the map at +0x98 (what SetProperty, slot 127, stores); found: the object AddRef'd into *out and true; else false, *out untouched; ret 8. EvaluateWindowCondition 0xb40d20 and LoadUIScript 0xb41b50 read the script's condition variants through it

name: ConvertRGBToNative
source: lane MG: 0x147360 forwards to the active draw buffer (slot 8) and its slot 30 (cGZBuffer::ConvertRGBValueToNative 0x8c65f0, byte arguments); the legacy text handlers turn a colour attribute into the native colour with it
